scope: Default-feature normal and build dependency closure for the Linux target, including proc macros and their build dependencies. Dev-only edges and the application's own package are excluded. This records available texts and metadata; it does not choose among dual-license alternatives.

runtime_components.name: Rust Standard Library
runtime_components.license: MIT OR Apache-2.0, with per-file and dependency notices in the copied document

text_availability_notes.note: Cargo metadata lists Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT, but this cached published crate includes only LICENSE-ZLIB.md. Its complete Zlib text is copied unchanged; missing alternate texts were not fabricated and no license alternative is selected here.
